limits: Same four frozen synthetic spectra, exact nominal centers and deterministic bands; no fresh random sample or physical apparatus
Input envelope is pointwise multiplicative with known support, timing and zero prehistory; target loading remains known
All observations are after a common reference loading; no in-loading samples, derivative data, mass cap or rate cap
Actual dose and peak may vary within the envelope; do not claim exactly matched actual dose or an unchanged hard peak cap
Different target waits evaluate different target responses; a passing late target is not improved precision on the original earlier target
Scale reduction and relative optimal-recovery formula are classical consequences, not independent algorithm novelty
Floating-point envelopes/replay, not directed rounding, noise calibration or external review
Failed continuation gates are retained; no post-result threshold change
